title.vi: Lệnh Đăng ký y khoa (Nhiệm kỳ) 2004
title.th: คำสั่งการขึ้นทะเบียนแพทย์ (วาระการดำรงตำแหน่ง) 2004

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Medical Registration (Term of Office) Order 2004 and shall come into operation on 25th August 2004.

2. A person elected on 4th November 2004 as a member of the Medical Council to take the place of a member of the Medical Council —
(a)who was appointed or elected before 24th January 2003; and
(b)whose term of office has expired,
shall hold office for a term of 24 months and 15 days, from 6th November 2004 to 20th November 2006 (both dates inclusive).
